visible.title: Streamlit 1.39.0 hang page
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

In 1.39.0 streamlit will hang after loading the page. It seems all components will load. But after that it will completely lock the brower tab.

1.37.1 works without problem on the same code.

This is running from a docker container tested both with python-3.12 and python-3.12-slim without any difference.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
none
```

### Steps To Reproduce

In 1.39.0 streamlit will hang after loading the page. It seems all components will load. But after that it will completely lock the brower tab.

1.37.1 works without problem on the same code.

This is running from a docker container tested both with python-3.12 and python-3.12-slim without any difference.

### Expected Behavior

the app should run

### Current Behavior

no message at all

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.39.0
- Python version: 3.12
- Operating System: Docker linux
- Browser: all

### Additional Information

none

gold.summary: After upgrading to 1.39.0 in Docker, browser tab locks up after load; 1.37.1 fine; no code given.
hypotheses: app-specific (custom components / heavy elements) interacting with a frontend change

missing_info.item: minimal reproducible app or list of components/elements used
missing_info.why: maintainers cannot reproduce; isolates app-specific cause

missing_info.item: does a minimal app (or streamlit hello) on 1.39 also hang

acceptable_next_steps: Request a minimal app/component list and browser console details.
Compare a minimal app across 1.37.1, 1.38 and 1.39 using otherwise identical deployments.
gold.reference: Maintainer couldn't reproduce, asked for app details; closed for inactivity.
gold.review_reason: A version comparison exists, but no minimal code or browser diagnostic evidence. App-specific frontend changes and a regression remain distinguishable possibilities.

acceptable_next_steps: Ask for a minimal repro and to test 1.38 vs 1.39
